page.overview:
Who is Nanday?

Nanday is the infant son of Mr. 9 and Miss Monday.

Nanday is a small baby with messy black hair. He wears a light blue onesie and a golden crown over his head.

Nanday appears to be a cheerful baby, having no fear while being juggled by his father.

Nanday was born on Cactus Island to Mr. 9 and Miss Monday, sometime during the last two years.
